title: Don't waste your money . . . Don't waste your money . . . Don't waste your money
text:
Don't waste your money . . . Don't waste your money . . . Don't waste your money. Absolute trash, cheaply made. Got the three containers and immediately realized these were worse than worst. Strainer fits in container fine, lid is very difficult to get on and once it is tightened down, forget about getting it back off. I am a large person with a strong grip and I gave up. I wanted to see if the container lid would seal good enough to keep the odor of an onion from coming out. Good thing I didn't put an onion in it as would have had to have been thrown away with the containers.
In case you didn't get the message, "DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY!"
